channel.title: AJDM Jakiur Rahman — Engineering Blog
channel.description: Practical articles on Laravel, WordPress, DevOps, Python web scraping, SaaS, and CRM/ERP by AJDM Jakiur Rahman, founder of Lunova Digital.

item.title: Web Scraping Services in Bangladesh: A Practical Guide for 2026
item.description: How professional web scraping actually works in Bangladesh — legal boundaries, the right tools (Scrapy, Playwright), anti-bot handling, and how to hire a reliable scraping engineer.

item.title: How to Hire the Best Software Engineer in Bangladesh (2026)
item.description: A practical framework for hiring a senior software engineer or development agency in Bangladesh — what to check, red flags to avoid, and why full-spectrum delivery beats a team of specialists.

item.title: How to Build a Multi-Tenant SaaS with Laravel
item.description: The two multi-tenancy models in Laravel — single database vs database-per-tenant — explained with trade-offs, tooling (Filament, Stripe), and how to choose for your SaaS.

item.title: Zero-Downtime Deployment with Docker & GitHub Actions
item.description: How to ship code with no downtime using Docker, GitHub Actions, and health-checked blue-green deploys — the CI/CD setup that cuts deploys from hours to minutes.

item.title: Custom WordPress Plugin Development: When You Actually Need One
item.description: When a custom WordPress plugin beats an off-the-shelf one, what professional plugin development involves, and how to avoid the security and update traps that break sites.

item.title: Custom CRM vs Off-the-Shelf: What Your Business Should Choose
item.description: A clear framework for deciding between a custom CRM/ERP and a subscription tool like Salesforce or Zoho — total cost, fit, ownership, and when each one wins.

item.title: Native Android vs Cross-Platform: How to Choose for Your App
item.description: Native Kotlin vs Flutter/React Native for your business app — the real trade-offs in performance, cost, team, and maintenance, and a simple rule for choosing.

item.title: How Much Does It Cost to Build a SaaS in 2026?
item.description: What actually drives the cost of building a SaaS product in 2026 — MVP vs full build, the real cost breakdown, and how to launch for less without cutting the wrong corners.
